description: Defines the MainResourceHandler class which manages resource loading, including obtaining XML documents, streams, URLs, and resource metadata, with specific focus on resource identification and comparison within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: MainResourceHandler
classes.description: A final class implementing ResourceHandler that manages resource loading and metadata retrieval for XML configuration files within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: MainResourceHandler(String, Element)
methods.description: Constructor initializing resource handler with XML filename and XML element attributes.

methods.name: MainResourceHandler(String, String, String)
methods.description: Constructor initializing resource handler with explicit loader name and location.

methods.name: getLoaderName
methods.description: Returns the loader name associated with the resource.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location of the resource.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Reads and returns the XML document from the resource stream.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Provides an InputStream to the resource.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the resource.

methods.name: isFileResource
methods.description: Checks if the resource is a file-based resource.

methods.name: getFullLocation
methods.description: Returns the full location path of the resource.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines equality based on loader name, filename, and location.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on filename, loader name, and location.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the resource handler.
